topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: A 45° scan range inherently increases beam overlap, leading to higher inter-beam power coupling and increased path loss. This necessitates larger antennas or sophisticated signal processing techniques like adaptive antenna systems for mitigating interference. The increased multipath fading at the edge of coverage further impacts link budget calculations due to reflections from buildings and terrain.  This trade-off requires a careful analysis of antenna design, transmission power, and modulation schemes to optimize performance.
